decoys.why_not_a_defect: attempt starts at 0 and is incremented before each call, so attempt numbers are 1-based as R4 requires. The increment placed before the try looks like an off-by-one but is correct.

The sleep uses 2 ** (attempt - 1), giving base_delay_s for the first failure and doubling thereafter, which is R3. It runs only before a retry, since the final-attempt raise on line 18 precedes it, so there is no sleep after the last attempt.
